intended_object: The plumbing graph with one vertex, framing (Euler number) w, and no edges. It describes the disk bundle over S² with Euler number w, whose boundary is the lens space L(-w,1) when w < 0. Inferred from the docstring and the `PlumbingGraph` structure.
explanation: In this library, `PlumbingGraph V` is a simple graph on `V` with decidable adjacency and an integer weight on each vertex. The definition takes `V = Fin 1`, the empty graph `⊥` (a single vertex has no edges anyway), and gives the one vertex the weight `w`. This is exactly the one-vertex plumbing diagram. Its intersection matrix is the 1×1 matrix (w). The docstring's remark is the standard fact that the boundary of the Euler-number-(−p) disk bundle over S² is L(p,1). The object is specific by nature, so it is not too narrow. Mathlib has no notion of plumbing graphs.
